observations: Photo 0 shows a close-up of a car engine or internal combustion engine component.
The component has a black plastic cover with a curved top and a circular indentation in the center.
There are visible hoses, electrical connectors, and a multicolored wire bundle (red, blue, yellow, black) attached to the side.
The engine appears to be removed from a vehicle and is sitting on a concrete or asphalt surface.
The plastic cover shows signs of wear, dirt, and some discoloration.
A watermark 'MOUS AUTO PARTS' is visible across the image.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the component itself.

claims.claim: We offer all our clients 5 star service (never buy an item because it's cheap, cause you might not...)

risks.risk: The engine may be damaged, non-functional, or missing critical parts.
risks.proof: A full 360-degree view of the engine, including the cylinder head, intake manifold, and oil pan, with close-ups of the cylinder bores and oil pan condition.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or incomplete

risks.risk: The engine may be from a specific vehicle model, which affects compatibility and value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine block with visible casting numbers or a VIN tag, or a photo of the engine installed in a vehicle.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic or unknown model

risks.risk: The engine may have been salvaged from a wrecked or accident-damaged vehicle.
risks.proof: A photo of the vehicle's VIN plate or a clear shot of the engine's serial number and any damage indicators.
risks.if_unproven: priced as salvage or unknown history

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or gearbox code: the plate, sticker or number stamped on the block or case.
A clear photo of the engine block showing casting numbers or serial number.
A 360-degree view of the engine, including the cylinder head and oil pan.
A photo of the vehicle the engine came from, or a VIN plate.
Close-up of the cylinder bores and oil pan condition.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
